claim: The explicitly Gale-realized record-14 completion is not the nerve of a compact hyperbolic Coxeter 9-polytope.
nonclaims: No other completion of record 14 is excluded.
No finite-volume noncompact Coxeter realization is excluded.
No Vinberg parabolic-cusp finite-volume audit is performed.
No global Coxeter labeling or Lorentzian Gram realization is supplied.

proof_logic.compact_vertex_condition: Every actual rank-nine vertex diagram must be elliptic.
proof_logic.inertia_obstruction: Zero cross edges give an orthogonal sum of two Lanner blocks; every surviving one-edge block has exact negative index two. Principal interlacing contradicts ambient compact H9 Gram inertia (9,1,4).
proof_logic.minimal_nonface_condition: Each of the two displayed minimal five-faces supports a labelled order-five Lanner diagram.
proof_logic.monotonicity: For normalized Gram I-A, increasing a finite cross label or adding cross edges increases A entrywise, so a local nonellipticity failure at m=3 cannot be repaired.

scope: One selected record-14 incidence completion only; other completions of the graph shadow remain outside the theorem.
